Vaani.intelligence.context#

Context Manager - Conversation Memory & State#

Features: - Short-term conversation memory (last N exchanges) - Long-term memory storage (persistent across restarts) - User preference tracking - Session state management - Context-aware query understanding - Memory pruning (keeps recent, relevant context) - Topic tracking and continuity - Entity tracking (people, places, things mentioned)

Tracks conversation history and context to enable natural, context-aware responses. Remembers what was discussed recently and maintains topic continuity.
